text:
Alex: Quick async check — dry-run for feature-x launch started. Please post a 1) what you did yesterday, 2) any blockers, 3) plan for today. Tag me for anything that needs an immediate page.

Priya: ✅ Dry-run kicked off, canary at 5% in eu-west1. Ran smoke flows and embeddings sanity; no 5xx so far. Blocker: intermittent OOM on rerank-worker when processing long context. Repro (minimal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank -d '{"q":"...","docs":[...long...]'}'
# leads to: ERROR: kv_cache oom after 120s
```
I'll collect heap profiles and open a ticket if I can't mitigate.

Jordan: Merged fix for flaky integration test (PR #4321). No blockers on infra side. Today I'll keep an eye on p50/p95 latency and validate throughput under 5% traffic. Added a short smoke script to run every 5m.

Sarah: Preparing the feature flag ramp to 10% in us-central but holding on perf gate. Blocker: flagging service needs a small config tweak (TTL) to avoid stale routing entries. @Luca can you push the config?

Luca: Pushed the TTL tweak at 11:40 PT, updated routing rule for feature-x. Noted one node with CPU spike — cordoned it and drained; autoscaler replaced it. No ongoing blocker from my side. Left a note in the runbook about the cordoned instance.

deploy-bot: canary-rollout: feature-x updated 5% -> 10% at 2024-05-12T18:40:50Z (id=dr-987) :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks. Priya — for the rerank OOM, please attach the heap/profile link here. If it looks blocking, swap back the quantization tweak on the model-serving container as a quick mitigation. Jordan, can you add an alert for p99 > 500ms to page eng-sre?

Priya: Quick inline log snippet: ```ERROR: KVCache::allocate failed - requested 512MB, available 320MB
stack: kv_cache.cpp:421 -> kv_store.cpp:88``` Opening ticket #548 and will drop heap profile in the ticket. If we need a hotfix, I'll coordinate revert.

Jordan: Alert rule added: service.feature-x.latency.p99 > 500ms -> page eng-sre. Test alert fired successfully in staging.

Sarah: No further blockers from my end. Plan: watch metrics for 30m at 10% then ramp to 25% if stable. Will post when I start the ramp.

Luca: Also added a short note in the ops channel about the node drain and the autoscaler behavior (so infra folks are aware).

Alex: Perfect — I'll consolidate these notes and post a rollout summary to #eng-releases in ~30m. If anyone sees anything critical, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
